headline: SABIC AN SAN-7 FID, Jinhui ultramax order, Saipem Caspian cable logistics
hook: SABIC AN takes FID on SAN-7 with a ~$3.5bn EPC to Samsung E&A. Jinhui orders two more ultramaxes, and Saipem hires SCA to move cable to the Caspian.
board: Of 42 new projects in the last 7 days, 30 are awarded and 4 are in tender. Energy leads with 28, and Europe (14) and Asia Pacific (13) account for most.
question: On a Samsung E&A-led fertilizer EPC like SAN-7, how many months after FID do you usually start talks on subcontract and equipment packages?

items.headline: SABIC AN takes FID on SAN-7 ammonia-urea complex in Al Jubail
items.statLabel: EPC contract awarded to Samsung E&A (approx.)
items.what: BCInsight (CRU) reports that SABIC Agri-Nutrients has taken FID on SAN-7 in Al Jubail. The project adds 1.2 million t/a of ammonia and 2.6 million t/a of urea capacity.
items.who: Owner: SABIC Agri-Nutrients. EPC: Samsung E&A. Licensors: Stamicarbon (MAIRE's Nextchem), thyssenkrupp Uhde Fertilizer Technology.
items.angle: The EPC is awarded and FID is taken on a large fertilizer complex, so Samsung E&A's procurement and subcontracting come next. This matters to fertilizer plant equipment suppliers and construction subcontractors in Saudi Arabia.
facts: The complex includes two urea plants
Nextchem, via Stamicarbon, supplies an NX STAMI Urea package under a EUR 125m contract
Stamicarbon's scope covers licensing, the Process Design Package and proprietary equipment
items.watch: Construction start, which the report expects in Q4 2026.

items.headline: Jinhui orders two 64,500 dwt ultramax bulkers at Jiangmen Nanyang
items.what: Splash247 reports that Jinhui Shipping has ordered two more ultramax bulkers from Jiangmen Nanyang Ship Engineering. This brings its ultramax newbuilding programme to 14 ships.
items.who: Owner: Jinhui Shipping and Transportation (via Jinmao Marine and Jinquan Marine). Shipyard: Jiangmen Nanyang Ship Engineering.
items.angle: This is an awarded newbuild order at a Chinese yard, part of a 14-ship programme across three yards. It matters to marine equipment and outfitting suppliers at Jiangmen Nanyang, New Dayang and Hantong, and to ship lenders.
facts: Around 65% of the price is funded by bank borrowing, the rest from internal resources
In June, Jinhui ordered two 64,100 dwt ships at New Dayang for $68m
Jinhui currently operates 19 vessels: 16 owned and 3 chartered-in
items.watch: Delivery of Jinhui's first 63,500 dwt ultramax from Jiangsu Hantong, scheduled for December this year per Splash247.

items.headline: Saipem awards Subsea Cable Assets ~$20m cable transport contract for Caspian
items.statLabel: Cable transport carousels to be supplied by SCA
items.what: Subsea Cable Assets (SCA) says it has won its first contract, worth about $20m, from Saipem Contracting Netherlands. SCA will move cable from load-out at JDR Cable Systems in the UK to the Caspian region.
items.who: Client: Saipem Contracting Netherlands. Contractor: Subsea Cable Assets (SCA). Cable load-out: JDR Cable Systems (UK).
items.angle: This awarded logistics package crosses several regions. It matters to cable transport vessel and barge operators, SPMT and heavy-transport providers, and load-out and port services on the UK–Southeastern Europe–Caspian route.
facts: Scope: engineering, fabrication, installation and operation, demobilization and reinstatement
In Southeastern Europe, SPMTs will move the loaded carousels onto smaller transport barges
SCA says it has delivered more than 50 carousels and related equipment worldwide
items.watch: The carousels are being manufactured at SCA's Dubai facility, with shipment to Europe planned by the end of 2026.
